io.writer

Class WriteCSV

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.writer.WriteCSV
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Writable, java.lang.AutoCloseable
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    AppendCSV

    public class WriteCSV
extends java.lang.Object
implements Writable
    Implements the Writable interface to create CSV files using field delimiters and quoted fields.
    • Released by Trevor Maggs on 15 April 2016
    • Modified to support for JDK1.7 NIO.2 functionality - 1 May 2017
    • Major improvements for efficient memory management - 22 November 2017
    • Fixed bug in addRow method - 23 January 2018
    • Flush method added to improve efficiency - 10 August 2020
    Version:
    0.6
    Author:
    Trevor Maggs

      • escapeEmbeddedCharacters

        private java.lang.String escapeEmbeddedCharacters(java.lang.String value,
                                                  boolean trimmed)
        Normalises, escapes, and quotes a CSV field when its contents require special handling.

        Leading and trailing whitespace is conditionally removed before the field is evaluated for CSV escaping. Fields containing quotation marks, the delimiter, or line-break characters are enclosed in double quotes. Embedded quotation marks are represented by two consecutive quotation marks.

        Parameters:
        value - field value to normalise and escape
        trimmed - true to strip leading and trailing whitespace; false to preserve it
        Returns:
        the CSV-safe representation of the field, or an empty string if value is null
